title: STM Holds Keel Laying Ceremony for Portugal’s Second Logistics Support Ship
summary: On October 20, 2026, Türkiye’s STM announced the keel-laying ceremony for the second logistics support ship for the Portuguese Navy in Istanbul. STM press release STM Savunma Teknolojileri Mühendislik ve Ticaret A.Ş. has reached another significant milestone in its international naval programmes. Selected by the …
detail: Türkiye's STM held a keel-laying ceremony on October 20, 2026, for Portugal's second logistics support ship (LSS) in Istanbul. This event marks a significant construction milestone for the vessel, which is part of an international naval program where STM was selected over other global shipbuilders. The keel-laying ceremony is a traditional naval event signifying the formal start of a ship's construction. These logistics support ships are crucial for the Portuguese Navy, as they extend the operational range and endurance of their fleet by providing essential supplies like fuel, provisions, and ammunition at sea. This capability allows the navy to sustain operations further from home ports, participate effectively in international missions, and conduct humanitarian aid. For Türkiye, the contract underscores the growing capabilities and international competitiveness of its defense shipbuilding industry, demonstrating its ability to secure significant defense contracts from NATO allies like Portugal. This collaboration also enhances interoperability within the NATO alliance, fostering shared logistical capabilities.

title: Alaska’s HAARP Site Now Being Used To Test New Air Force Over-The-Horizon Radar Tech
summary: The pursuit of over-the-horizon radars to watch over the strategic High North could point to a new role for the HAARP site. The post Alaska’s HAARP Site Now Being Used To Test New Air Force Over-The-Horizon Radar Tech appeared first on TWZ .
detail: The High-frequency Active Auroral Research Program (HAARP) site in Alaska is now being utilized by the U.S. Air Force to test new over-the-horizon (OTH) radar technology. HAARP, known for its powerful high-frequency radio transmission capabilities used for ionospheric research, is now contributing to advanced defense technology. This development is significant because the Arctic region, often referred to as the High North, is rapidly gaining strategic importance due to climate change opening new shipping routes and increased military activity. Over-the-horizon radars are vital for monitoring these vast and remote areas, as they can detect objects far beyond the curvature of the Earth, unlike conventional line-of-sight radars. Improved OTH radar capabilities will enhance early warning systems against potential threats such as cruise missiles and aircraft, providing better domain awareness over challenging environments. This new role for HAARP demonstrates its practical application in national defense, leveraging its unique infrastructure to develop critical surveillance technologies for a strategically vital region.

title: Ghost Shark Extra-Large Uncrewed Underwater Vehicles’ Payload Bay Seen For First Time
summary: Ghost Shark will deploy aerial drones, lay mines, and execute seabed resupply missions as part of Australia’s new undersea arsenal. The post Ghost Shark Extra-Large Uncrewed Underwater Vehicles’ Payload Bay Seen For First Time appeared first on TWZ .
detail: Australia has publicly revealed the payload bay of its Ghost Shark Extra-Large Uncrewed Underwater Vehicle (XLUUV) for the first time. This advanced autonomous submarine is designed for a diverse range of missions, including deploying aerial drones, laying mines, and executing seabed resupply operations. The revelation of the payload bay signifies substantial progress in the vehicle's development and highlights its intended operational flexibility. This development is a major step forward in Australia's undersea warfare capabilities, as XLUUVs offer a stealthy, persistent, and potentially expendable platform for operations in contested waters. Their multi-mission capability means they can contribute to intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR), offensive operations, and logistical support without risking human crews. XLUUVs represent a significant trend in modern naval technology, enabling navies to project power and conduct operations in dangerous environments more efficiently and potentially at a lower cost than traditional crewed submarines, particularly relevant for vast maritime regions like the Indo-Pacific.

title: Retired KC-10 Extender Tanker Has Risen From Boneyard To Fly Again
summary: The ex-USAF KC-10 is now headed for a second career in the private sector with Omega Air Refueling. The post Retired KC-10 Extender Tanker Has Risen From Boneyard To Fly Again appeared first on TWZ .
detail: A retired U.S. Air Force (USAF) KC-10 Extender aerial refueling tanker, previously stored in the "boneyard" (Aerospace Maintenance and Regeneration Group, AMARG) at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base, has been reactivated and is set for a second career with Omega Air Refueling, a private company. This event highlights the growing role of private contractors in providing specialized military support services, such as aerial refueling. Omega Air Refueling offers "for-hire" refueling services to various militaries, including the U.S. Navy and Marine Corps, which helps reduce the operational strain on their own tanker fleets and provides cost-effective training opportunities. Reactivating a retired aircraft demonstrates the value of preserving assets in storage and the potential for extending their operational life beyond initial military service. It represents a cost-effective method to meet the high demand for aerial refueling capabilities, especially as the USAF phases out its KC-10 fleet in favor of newer KC-46s. The KC-10's continued service, even in a private capacity, extends the legacy of this robust and capable tanker.

title: Major Ukrainian Arms Maker Rethinking Future Reliance On Starlink
summary: Reducing the speed at which weapons using Starlink can operate affects critical defensive and offensive weapons, but any alternatives have massive drawbacks. The post Major Ukrainian Arms Maker Rethinking Future Reliance On Starlink appeared first on TWZ .
detail: A major Ukrainian arms manufacturer is re-evaluating its future reliance on Starlink satellite internet services due to concerns over operational speed reductions affecting weapons systems that utilize the service. While alternative communication solutions exist, they reportedly come with significant drawbacks. Starlink has played a critical role in Ukraine's defense, providing vital communication capabilities for military units in areas where traditional infrastructure is compromised or unreliable. Its low-latency, high-bandwidth service has been instrumental for command and control, drone operations, and intelligence sharing. This situation underscores the inherent risks of depending on commercial, privately-owned infrastructure for critical military operations, as changes in service terms, technical limitations, or geopolitical pressures can directly impact battlefield effectiveness. Reduced speed or reliability of Starlink could severely hamper the performance of advanced Ukrainian weapons systems that rely on real-time data for targeting, navigation, or coordination, affecting both defensive and offensive capabilities. This necessitates Ukraine's search for diversified communication channels or the development of indigenous, military-grade satellite communication solutions to maintain operational autonomy and resilience.

title: Meta’s Muse hits 10M U.S. downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
summary: Meta's AI companion Muse has surpassed 10 million U.S. downloads in its first 40 days, joining an exclusive group of apps that includes Threads. New data also shows Muse is retaining users at higher rates than its AI rivals.
detail: Meta's new AI companion app, Muse, achieved a significant milestone by reaching 10 million U.S. downloads within its first 40 days, a rapid adoption rate matched by only a handful of other apps, including Meta's own Threads. Data also indicates that Muse is retaining users at higher rates compared to its AI competitors. This rapid growth and strong user retention are crucial indicators of success for a new application. For Meta, it validates their substantial investment in artificial intelligence and their strategy to integrate AI features across their ecosystem, potentially opening new avenues for user engagement and data collection. This performance positions Muse as a strong contender in the evolving AI companion market, signaling Meta's capability to drive large-scale adoption for its AI initiatives and intensifying competition with other major tech players in the AI space.

title: SpaceX will try catching Starship and its booster for first time, Musk says
summary: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk said the company would attempt to catch Starship and its booster next month, with the goal of recovering the entire orbital launch system for the first time. If successful, Musk said, the attempt would mark the first time in history an orbital launch vehicle has been fully recovered. "This is a […]
detail: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk announced plans to attempt a full recovery of its Starship spacecraft and its Super Heavy booster by 'catching' both stages upon their return to Earth, marking the first time such a feat would be attempted for an orbital launch system. This endeavor is a critical step towards achieving full reusability in spaceflight, which is considered the 'holy grail' for drastically reducing launch costs and enabling more frequent missions. While SpaceX has successfully recovered and reused the booster stages of its Falcon 9 rockets, recovering the entire Starship system (both the upper stage and the booster) would be an unprecedented engineering achievement. This innovation is central to SpaceX's long-term ambitions of making space travel routine and affordable, facilitating large-scale satellite deployment, and ultimately enabling human missions to Mars. The 'catching' method involves using the launch tower's arms to secure the descending vehicles, a highly ambitious and complex maneuver designed to streamline recovery operations.

summary: A new gadget we've just come across might be the best piece of decor you'll add to your home this year. It's arguably the first-ever ePaper display that can display art and photos using nothing but the power of the Sun. Continue Reading Category: Around The Home , Consumer Tech , Technology Tags: Home decor , Art , …
detail: A new ePaper display has been introduced that can showcase art and photos using only ambient light, effectively eliminating the need for external power chargers. This innovation addresses a common challenge for digital art displays, which often require visible power cords or frequent battery recharging. By being entirely self-sufficient through solar power, the device offers unprecedented flexibility in placement within a home or office, as it is not tethered to an electrical outlet. This advancement could significantly enhance the aesthetic appeal and practicality of digital art in home decor, allowing technology to blend more seamlessly into living spaces without visual clutter. It also highlights ongoing progress in low-power display technologies and efficient energy harvesting, making smart home devices more environmentally friendly and user-convenient by reducing energy consumption and maintenance requirements.

title: Netflix is telling investors not to worry, even though you’re watching less and less
summary: Netflix is making monetization a top priority amid reports of falling viewing time. As part of its third-quarter earnings report on Tuesday, Netflix lists improvements to monetization as one of its main focuses going forward, alongside efforts to boost entertainment value and leverage new technology. The streaming …
detail: In its third-quarter earnings report, Netflix reassured investors by prioritizing monetization improvements, enhancing entertainment value, and leveraging new technology, despite facing reports of declining user viewing time. This strategic emphasis signals a shift for the streaming giant. Historically focused on subscriber growth and content acquisition, Netflix is now concentrating on extracting more value from its existing subscriber base and developing new revenue streams, such as its ad-supported tiers and efforts to curb password sharing. Declining viewing time is a significant concern for investors, as it can indicate reduced engagement, potential subscriber churn, and slower future growth. Netflix's challenge is to convince the market that it can sustain profitability and growth in a mature and highly competitive streaming landscape, balancing monetization strategies with maintaining a high-quality user experience and compelling content to retain its audience.

title: Snap is paying Robert Downey Jr. to do the Iron Man thing
summary: Snap has a new brand ambassador for its Specs AR glasses: Iron Man actor Robert Downey Jr. The company has brought on Downey as Specs' "Chief Customer Experience Officer" and has published several videos featuring Downey showcasing the capabilities of the new glasses, including as a tool to get help with a putt, …
detail: Snap Inc. has engaged actor Robert Downey Jr. as its 'Chief Customer Experience Officer' for its Specs augmented reality (AR) glasses, featuring him prominently in promotional videos that demonstrate the glasses' capabilities. This high-profile celebrity endorsement aims to significantly boost the visibility and appeal of Snap's AR hardware. Robert Downey Jr., widely recognized for his role as Iron Man—a character synonymous with advanced technology and augmented reality—brings substantial star power and thematic relevance to the product. The move underscores Snap's commitment to pushing its AR glasses into the mainstream consumer market, leveraging a recognizable and tech-savvy persona to bridge the gap between niche technology and mass adoption. This marketing strategy is designed to make AR glasses appear cool, useful, and accessible, addressing the common challenge of demonstrating practical utility and overcoming adoption hurdles for nascent AR technologies.
